html:
Ha Long cruise not only brings you relaxing moments, new experiences, but when participating in the cruise, you can also enjoy cuisine on Ha Long cruise prepared by talented chefs, with delicious and attractive dishes and 5-star resort services that will bring visitors the most enjoyable vacation.

When it comes to Ha Long cruise, Queen cruise always brings visitors new experiences, on the cruise there are full night tourism resort services to take visitors to visit Ha Long Bay, Bai Tu Long and fully explore the beauty of the bay.

The experience on Ha Long cruise will bring visitors interesting experiences and enjoy delicious dishes, especially on Queen cruise which has reached 5-star standards, with diverse menus, diners will be free to choose.

On the Queen cruise, visitors will enjoy a variety of dishes for diners to choose from, including counters such as: Appetizer counter, salad counter, sushi/sashimi counter, grilled food counter…

At the appetizer counter, there are dishes such as:

  • Seafood soup
  • Butter Balls
  • French bread
  • Fruit jam
  • Strawberry jam balls
  • Avocado fried potatoes

Salad counter

  • Shredded chicken rib salad
  • Jellyfish salad
  • Five-color cold meat salad
  • Ha Long spring rolls

Sushi and Sashimi counter

  • Seafood Sashimi rice rolls
  • Mixed Sashimi rice rolls
  • Korean kimchi
  • Herring sashimi
  • Japanese crab stick sashimi

Grilled food counter

  • German sausage
  • Coconut steamed shrimp
  • Grilled fish with satay/fried fish with butter
  • Grilled oysters/Blue clams with spring onions
  • Honey grilled chicken wings

Hot food counter

  • Five-color stir-fried squid
  • Beef stewed with vegetables
  • Beer steamed/salted fried
  • Stir-fried vegetables (seasonal)
  • Seasoned vermicelli
  • Mixed fried rice
  • Sweet and sour clams
  • Rice rolls with cinnamon sausage

Che stall

  • Lotus seed and longan sweet soup
  • Green bean and coconut sweet soup
  • Black jelly
  • Agar jelly
  • Coconut jelly
  • Crispy dried coconut

In addition, on the cruise there are also dessert stalls, and snacks for visitors to enjoy, or drinks for visitors to enjoy while admiring the scenery and enjoying the dishes right on the cruise.

So if you are wondering which cruise to choose when going on a Ha Long cruise, according to the Ha Long travel experience from Vietlook Travel, you should choose the 5-star Queen cruise Ha Long, which will bring you the most enjoyable vacation in the island paradise.
